evidence_items.source_title: What Betfair Exchange market data is available from listMarketBook / Stream API? - Betfair Developer Program
evidence_items.claim_summary: The Exchange API returns Betfair's own exchange market data (back/lay prices, last traded price, traded volume) — a single exchange operator's prices, not aggregated external bookmaker feeds.
evidence_items.excerpt: The screenshot shows the equivalent data on the Betfair Exchange website.
evidence_items.notes: Operator-level, but the operator is a single exchange (Betfair). See betfair-operator-identity.

evidence_items.source_title: What Betfair Exchange market data is available from listMarketBook / Stream API? - Betfair Developer Program
evidence_items.claim_summary: The quoted operator is unambiguously Betfair (a single exchange). There is exactly one operator identity, so the source cannot supply multiple distinct operators.
evidence_items.notes: Provider identity (Betfair) equals the single operator identity here; governed multi-operator Consensus/SpotBoard requires several distinct operators (DEC-013).

evidence_items.source_title: What Betfair Exchange market data is available from listMarketBook / Stream API? - Betfair Developer Program
evidence_items.claim_summary: The accessible support article documents exchange market-data content but did not document identifier/timestamp field names or any data-use (retention/display/redistribution) rights; the deeper API reference pages were not retrievable in this sprint.
evidence_items.notes: Because no retrieved primary source established data-use rights, all Betfair rights are recorded UNKNOWN and fail closed.
